title: Solar energy stories vs data centers and grid stories on points
question: Does a story about solar energy get more points than a story about data centers and grid?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about solar energy gets more points than a story about data centers and grid.
expect: If true, points per story for solar energy stories should be at least 1.5x the value for data centers and grid stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, solar energy against data centers and grid

group_b.label: Data centers and grid stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h328 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h328 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
